screen: Competency Management — Development & Career Path Workspace (cm-development-career) + Audit & Activity Center (cm-audit)

features.element: Development & Career Path Workspace (H1) + Info icon
features.purpose: Screen title; the Info icon reads as a help/tooltip affordance
features.shouldFeed: Nothing — but an Info affordance should open the module's help/tour, which Organization/HRIT already logs via tbl_user_journey_logs (tour_step_view events consumed by the Audit centre's Screen access log)
features.gap: <Info> is a bare lucide icon with no onClick, no title, no Popover. Pure decoration that looks clickable.

features.purpose: Opens the plan create dialog from any tab
features.shouldFeed: Talent Mgmt succession/9-box (a plan is the remediation record behind a readiness score) and LMS (the plan should generate the learning path)
features.gap: Plan rows are only ever read by Competency itself. grep of s_competency_development_plans shows consumers = DevelopmentPlanController, CareerPathController, EmployeeCompetencyProfileController, LearningAssignmentController, skillLibraryController, CommandCenterService — all Competency. Zero Talent Mgmt reads.

features.purpose: Opens the career-path create dialog from any tab
features.shouldFeed: Talent Management succession planning — a succession plan's target role and pipeline should be the career path, per the spec's 'Succession pipeline view — competency readiness'
features.gap: s_competency_career_paths / _steps are read by exactly two files, both in Api/Competency. SuccessionPlanController reads only talent_succession_plans / talent_succession_candidates and stores its own hand-typed `readiness` enum — a duplicate build of the readiness concept the explorer already computes.

features.purpose: Opens the bulk course-assignment dialog from any tab
features.shouldFeed: LMS delivery — the learner's My Learning queue and lms_course_enroll, so the assigned course is actually takeable and its completion flows back
features.gap: The row lands in lms_assignments and IS visible in the LMS admin Assignment Queue (assignmentController@index selects a.source/a.competency_id/a.development_plan_id). But no lms_course_enroll row is created, and LmsLearningController (My Learning) never queries lms_assignments — grep returns zero hits. The employee is never actually enrolled and never sees the course.

features.purpose: States that the screen was opened filtered to one competency; clears the filter
features.shouldFeed: Competency Library detail panel → this screen (drill-through)
features.gap: The only caller that sets ?competency_id is cm-competency-library.tsx:797, which pushes `/module/m2/{submenuId}/{submenuId}?...`. content-map-m2.ts registers the real accessLink as `/module/competency-management/competency-library/development-and-career-paths` and use-content-map.ts keys modules by numeric id ('2'), not 'm2'. parseRoutePath returns null for the m2 URL, so the shell falls back to HOME_NAV. The drill-through never lands here, so the banner is unreachable.

features.purpose: Count of status='active' plans, with month-over-month delta
features.shouldFeed: Competency Command Center and Talent Mgmt workforce-readiness reporting
features.gap: Not clickable — no drilldown into the filtered list, unlike the Audit centre's KPI cards which are buttons.

features.element: KPI: Plans In Progress + donut ring
features.purpose: Count of active plans with 0<progress<100; ring shows a percentage
features.gap: Mislabelled metric. The ring renders metrics.in_progress_percent, which DevelopmentPlanController.php:187 computes as the MEAN progress of in-progress plans — not the share of plans in progress. A user reads '43%' as '43% of plans are in progress'. Also not clickable.

features.shouldFeed: L&D ROI / competency-uplift reporting (spec: 'Training/L&D cost vs. competency uplift ROI view')
features.gap: Completion is never correlated with any competency level change — s_skill_matrix is never written on plan completion, so 'plan completed' proves nothing about capability.
Counts an object nothing outside Competency consumes.

features.purpose: Count of lms_assignments rows with source='competency'
features.gap: Counts assignments, not enrolments or completions — and since no enrolment is created, this number can be large while zero learning has been delivered.

features.purpose: Plan list + detail split view + explorer

features.gap: Switching tabs resets selectedPlanId but not focusedPathId, so returning to Career Paths re-focuses a possibly deleted path.
Backend searches ONLY `title` (DevelopmentPlanController.php:96-98). Typing an employee name or job role returns nothing, though both are shown as columns.

features.purpose: All / In Progress / Completed / Overdue / On Hold
features.gap: 'Overdue' is a stored status that nothing ever sets automatically. No scheduler, no observer (app/Events, app/Listeners, app/Observers do not exist). A plan past due_date stays 'In Progress' forever unless a human edits it, so the Overdue option is permanently near-empty.

features.shouldFeed: Should read department from Organization/HRIT as source of truth
features.gap: Filters on the department_id snapshotted onto the plan at create time (and typed manually — see the Department field), not on the employee's live tbluser.department_id. A transferred employee's plan stays filed under the old department.

features.shouldFeed: Organization/HRIT reporting hierarchy — the owner should default to the employee's manager
features.gap: owners() (DevelopmentPlanController.php:248-251) plucks distinct approver_id from plans that already exist. No manager lookup from tbluser/reporting hierarchy.

features.purpose: Opens a secondary filter panel; badge counts active filters
features.gap: Duplicates Department and Plan Owner, which are already in the toolbar whenever no plan is selected — two controls bound to the same state.

features.purpose: Same department filter inside the popover
features.gap: Redundant with the toolbar control.

features.purpose: Same owner filter inside the popover
features.gap: Redundant with the toolbar control.

features.purpose: Show only plans awaiting the current user's sign-off
features.shouldFeed: Department Head sign-off queue (spec: 'Sign-off on individual development plans & training nominations') and the Audit centre's Approvals tab
features.gap: Two defects. (1) The word 'my' is false: DevelopmentPlanController.php:119-121 applies only `where('approval_status','pending_approval')` with NO approver_id = context user filter, so it shows everyone's pending plans. (2) There is no approve/reject action anywhere — ApprovalController::SUBJECTS covers only 'competency' and 'framework'; a plan set to pending_approval can never leave that state.
Does not clear the search box, so the empty-state text ('No plans match the current filters') can still be triggered after 'Clear all'.

features.shouldFeed: Employee Competency Profile (cm-employee-profiles) — clicking the employee should open their profile
features.gap: Not a link. No navigation to the employee's competency profile, even though EmployeeCompetencyProfileController@developmentPlans already exposes the reverse link.

features.shouldFeed: Organization/HRIT job-role master (s_user_jobrole) should be the single source
features.gap: jobrole is a free-text snapshot copied from the employee at plan creation (PlanForm line 488). It is never re-synced when the employee's tbluser.jobtitle_id changes, and the Competency Gaps tab computes against this stale string — so a promoted employee's gaps are measured against their old role.

features.shouldFeed: Notification/reminder engine (spec: 'Notification/reminder engine for assessment cycles & deadlines') and Task Management as an executable work item
features.gap: No reminders exist anywhere in the codebase (no app/Events, app/Listeners, app/Observers; app/Jobs holds one unrelated job). Due date is display-only and does not even drive the Overdue status.

features.shouldFeed: Should be driven by LMS completion of the plan's assigned courses, not only by manual action ticks
features.gap: syncPlanProgress (DevelopmentPlanController.php:1077-1101) counts ONLY s_competency_plan_actions. lms_assignments.development_plan_id is written but never read for progress — grep of development_plan_id shows no consumer that touches plan progress. Completing an assigned course leaves the plan at the same percentage. The comment in lms/assignment/assignmentController.php:260-268 claiming Competency 'reads progress back to show plan completion' is factually wrong.
Renders '—' silently when unassigned; no visual distinction from a user whose initials failed to resolve.

features.element: Plan row click → open detail panel
features.purpose: Selects the plan and opens the right-hand detail card

features.gap: Duplicate of the row click.

features.purpose: Opens PlanForm seeded from the list row
features.gap: The list row carries no objective/focus_areas, so opening Edit from the table and saving submits objective:'' and focus_areas:'' (PlanForm line 496-497 sends them whenever editing) — silently wiping both fields the user never saw.

features.purpose: Opens the assign dialog preset to this employee + plan
features.shouldFeed: LMS enrolment + the plan's own progress
features.gap: Presets employee and development_plan_id but NOT competency_id, so the assignment is never tagged with the gap it closes (see AssignLearningForm).
Logs 'deleted_development_plan' with no diff; linked lms_assignments rows keep the dangling development_plan_id (unlike career-path delete, which nulls the FK).

features.element: Delete development plan confirmation dialog (Cancel / Delete)
features.purpose: Confirms plan deletion, names the employee
features.gap: Does not warn that linked learning assignments will be orphaned.

features.element: Plans list Pager (per-page select, prev, page numbers, next)
Plans empty state + 'Create Development Plan' CTA
features.purpose: Zero-state guidance, distinguishes filtered vs truly empty
Refetch after a failed list load
Opens PlanForm with the FULL detail (objective + focus areas)
features.gap: After a successful save the detail panel is never reloaded: usePlanDetail depends only on planId (use-development-career.ts:290) and refreshKey is not in its deps. The panel keeps showing the pre-edit values until the plan is re-selected.

features.purpose: Assign a course to this plan's employee, tagged to this plan
features.gap: Same as header Assign Learning: no enrolment, no competency tagging, no progress feedback into the plan.

features.purpose: Status badge in the detail header

features.shouldFeed: Task Management (a plan period should scope the executable work)
features.gap: No link to Task Mgmt; no elapsed/remaining indicator.

features.shouldFeed: Approval queue in the Audit centre
features.gap: Shows an owner but offers no Approve/Reject/Submit control — the sign-off the spec requires has no UI.
Derived only from plan actions (see Progress column).

features.purpose: Objective, focus areas, next milestone, linked path
Required vs current proficiency for the plan's job role
Chronological change feed for the plan
features.gap: Labelled 'Notes & History' but there is no note input anywhere in the tab (lines 1502-1522 render a read-only list plus an empty state). Nothing on this screen can produce a 'comment'-class audit row, so plan discussion never reaches the Audit centre's Comments tab. Spec asks for a 'Feedback/comment tool tied to each competency rating'.

features.shouldFeed: Competency Library — focus areas ARE competencies and should be FK references, not free text
features.gap: Stored as a comma-joined free-text string (joinList/splitList). The Gaps tab matches them to competencies by case-insensitive exact name (isFocusArea, DevelopmentPlanController.php:1123-1131). A typo or renamed competency silently drops the Focus badge. No competency_id linkage.

features.element: Overview: Next Milestone card + status badge
features.shouldFeed: Task Management — a milestone is executable work
features.gap: No task is created; not clickable; does not jump to the Actions tab.

features.purpose: Jumps to the Career Paths tab focused on the linked path
features.gap: Closes the detail panel as a side effect (line 2415), losing the user's place.

features.purpose: Count of competencies the job role requires
features.gap: Zero when plan.jobrole is null or unmapped, with only a generic empty state.

features.shouldFeed: LMS — each gap should generate a targeted course assignment (spec: 'Competency gap scores → feed Targeted Training Plan assignment (LMS)')
features.gap: Not clickable. No 'assign learning for these gaps' action anywhere.

Row key and join are by skill NAME: gaps() keys required by `skill` and current by `title` (DevelopmentPlanController.php:601,610). competency_id is null for any required competency the employee has never been rated on, so the row can never link back to the library entry. Not clickable either.

features.shouldFeed: n/a — this is the Competency module's own definition, correctly owned
Should be produced by the Assessment workspace (measure) and by LMS completion (build)
features.gap: THE CENTRAL BREAK. s_skill_matrix is written by exactly two manual admin endpoints in EmployeeCompetencyProfileController (addSkill/updateSkill). AssessmentController writes only s_competency_assessments and never touches s_skill_matrix; no LMS controller writes it either. So the 'Current' column reflects hand-typed profile ratings — not assessment results, not course completions. The customer's premise that a plan 'consumes a GAP from assessment' is NOT satisfied: the gap is computed live from a manual matrix, and the assessment result never reaches it.

features.shouldFeed: LMS course recommendation, Talent readiness, and the plan's own Actions list
features.gap: Read-only cell. There is no per-row action (no 'Add action', no 'Assign course'), so the gap → remediation link is entirely manual and untracked. Also unassessed competencies default current=0, so an employee simply never rated shows a maximal fabricated gap.

features.element: Gaps empty states ('No gap data' / 'No required competencies mapped')
features.purpose: Explains why the tab is empty
features.gap: Neither state offers a route to Framework & Role Mapping to fix the missing role→competency mapping.

features.purpose: 'X of Y complete — progress recalculates automatically'
Opens ActionForm to create a plan action
features.shouldFeed: Task Management — an action is executable work and should become a task
features.gap: No task is created in Task Mgmt. Action type 'project'/'training'/'mentoring' exist as labels only.

features.purpose: Toggles an action between completed and pending; recalculates plan progress
features.shouldFeed: The plans TABLE row on the left, and the KPI cards
features.gap: onChanged→refresh() bumps refreshKey, but useDevelopmentPlans(listParams) does not include refreshKey in its params (cm-development-career.tsx:1990-2021), so the left-hand table's Progress bar and Status badge stay stale after ticking an action. Only the KPIs and sibling tabs refresh.

features.shouldFeed: Audit centre Version History (diff labels are supplied)

features.purpose: Soft-deletes the action and recomputes progress
features.gap: No confirmation dialog — a single menu click destroys the action, unlike plan/path/assignment deletes which all confirm.
No CTA button, unlike the other empty states on this screen.

features.purpose: Renders description, actor, timestamp per audit row
features.gap: Entries are not clickable through to the Audit centre's Change Summary, so the field-level diff recorded on updates is invisible here.

features.purpose: Who the plan is for; also carries their job role into the plan
features.reads: tbluser + s_user_jobrole (jobtitle_id else first numeric of allocated_standards)
features.shouldFeed: Organization/HRIT identity is correctly the source
features.gap: Capped at 500 users with no server-side search wired from this control (getEmployees accepts ?search but the select never sends one). On a tenant >500 employees, people are silently unpickable. Also the selected employee's department_id is available on the option but is NOT used to prefill the Department field.

Chicken-and-egg bug: owners() returns only users who already own a plan (DevelopmentPlanController.php:248-251). On a fresh tenant the list is empty, so no owner can ever be set, so no plan can ever enter approval. And even when set, nothing can approve it — ApprovalController has no 'development_plan' subject.

features.purpose: Files the plan under a department
features.gap: Manually chosen and defaults to 'Not set' even though the selected employee's department_id is already loaded in EmployeeOption. Nothing validates that the department matches the employee's.

features.purpose: In Progress / Completed / Overdue / On Hold
features.writes: status; completed_at; forces progress=100 on completed
features.gap: Lets a user set 'Completed' (and thereby progress=100) with zero completed actions and zero closed gaps.
No validation that start_date <= due_date, client or server (planRules only checks 'date').
No reminder mechanism exists and no job flips status to overdue.

features.purpose: Associates the plan with a named career path
features.shouldFeed: Career Path Explorer (it does drive node resolution) and Talent succession
features.gap: Explorer honours it (CareerPathController.php:328-331). Talent Mgmt does not read it at all. The picker lists ALL paths including archived ones — useCareerPaths({}, refreshKey) passes no status filter.
Silently wiped when the form is opened from a table row (row shape has no objective) — see 'Row kebab → Edit Plan'.

features.shouldFeed: Competency Library (should be a multi-select of real competencies)
features.gap: Free-text with no autocomplete against s_users_skills. The Gaps tab's Focus badge relies on an exact case-insensitive name match, so any typo silently breaks the link. Same wipe-on-row-edit hazard as Objective.

features.purpose: Shows 'Plan name is required' / 'Select the employee' / server errors

features.gap: No dirty-state guard; unsaved edits vanish silently.

features.shouldFeed: Audit centre (create logs no diff; update logs a full diff via CHANGE_LABELS)

features.purpose: Scopes the path to a department
features.gap: index() supports a department_id filter but the Career Paths tab exposes no department filter, so the value is write-only in practice.

features.shouldFeed: Approval workflow — a path is a governance object like a framework
features.gap: Draft→Active is a plain dropdown edit with no approval step, unlike frameworks which route through ApprovalController (draft→active). Archived paths still appear in the plan form's Linked Career Path picker.
Never rendered anywhere — not in the Career Paths table, not in the Explorer card.

features.purpose: Ordered job roles making up the path
features.shouldFeed: This IS the job-role matrix consumption — correctly sourced
features.gap: Steps are stored by NAME with a best-effort id lookup (replaceSteps, CareerPathController.php:520). Renaming a job role in Organization silently orphans every step. Role list is capped at 500 and the select sends no search term.

features.purpose: Removes a step; disabled below 2 steps

features.gap: No reordering (no drag, no up/down). Order is fixed by insertion, and step_type is auto-derived as current/next/future by index (lines 685-688), so the author cannot express which role is the entry point independently of ordering.

features.element: CareerPathForm: Cancel / Create Path / Save Changes
features.gap: Path update logs 'updated_career_path' with NO diff (CareerPathController.php:239-247 passes no $changes), so career path edits never appear in the Audit centre's Version History tab even though plan and assignment edits do.

features.purpose: job_family is in the payload type, the validator and the DB column
features.shouldFeed: Talent Mgmt job-family based succession and Organization job architecture
features.gap: No input renders it. CareerPathSummary.job_family is returned by the API and is never displayed either.

features.shouldFeed: LMS course catalog is correctly the source
features.gap: Reads sub_std_map (the K-12 subject↔standard table reused as the HRMS course catalog), capped at 300, no search term sent, and shows no indication of which competencies the course builds — there is no skills-to-course mapping consulted, which the spec calls for ('Skills-to-course mapping (LMS) → powers auto-recommended learning').
LMS admin sees the value but nothing enforces 'Mandatory' — no escalation, no blocking, no reminder.
LmsAssignment stats compute overdue on the fly, but nothing writes status='Overdue' on the competency side, and there is no reminder mechanism.

features.purpose: Client-side filter of the employee checkbox list
features.gap: Filters only the 500 rows already fetched; employee 501 is unreachable.
No 'select all' / 'select filtered' control; no way to target a whole department or job role, which is the natural unit for a competency-driven training push.

features.purpose: competency_id exists in LearningAssignmentPayload, the validator and the DB column
features.shouldFeed: The competency's own detail panel ('Learning Assigned' drill-through) and gap-closure reporting
features.gap: The submit payload at lines 836-842 sends course_id, user_ids, assignment_type, due_date, development_plan_id — never competency_id. So every assignment created here is untagged, the ?competency_id= filter on the Learning Assignments tab can never match a plan-driven assignment, and there is no record of WHICH gap a course was meant to close.

features.shouldFeed: LMS enrolment + learner My Learning + completion feedback into the plan
features.gap: Writes the assignment only. No lms_course_enroll row, so the learner is never enrolled; LmsLearningController never reads lms_assignments; and completion never returns to plan progress. The gap→course→completion→level loop is broken at both ends.

features.purpose: milestone / training / mentoring / project / reading / other
features.shouldFeed: 'training' should create an LMS assignment; 'project' should create a Task Mgmt task
features.gap: Type is a label only. Selecting 'training' does not offer or create a course assignment; 'project' does not create a task. Six types, zero behavioural difference.

features.shouldFeed: Plan progress (works) and Audit centre ('completed_plan_action' gets its own verb)
features.gap: 'blocked' has no escalation path or reason field.

features.purpose: Action deadline; drives Next Milestone ordering
features.gap: No reminder engine; not validated against the plan's own due_date.

features.purpose: competency_id is validated by storeAction/updateAction and returned as competency_name by actions()
features.line: cm-development-career.tsx:944 (form has no such field) / DevelopmentPlanController.php:723,687
features.shouldFeed: The Competency Gaps tab — an action should be attached to the gap it closes
features.gap: The backend joins s_users_skills to surface competency_name on every action and the type declares competency_id, but no form field exists. Consequence: an action can never be traced to a gap, and the Gaps tab can never show 'remediation in progress'.

features.purpose: owner_id is validated and rendered as owner_name on the action row
features.shouldFeed: Task Management assignment; manager coaching workload
features.gap: No field, so every action is silently owned by the employee. A mentoring action can never be assigned to the mentor.

features.element: ActionForm: Cancel / Add Action / Save Changes
features.shouldFeed: Audit centre (diff labels supplied for updates)

features.element: Career Path Explorer: card header + Info icon
features.gap: The Info icon at line 1112 has no handler or tooltip — decorative.

features.element: Career Path Explorer: 'View Full Path' button
features.purpose: Jump to the Career Paths tab focused on the shown path
features.gap: On the Career Paths tab the same card is rendered with onViewFullPath={(id) => onFocusPath(id)} (line 1676) — it re-focuses the path already focused, so the button is a visible no-op there. It is also enabled whenever `explorer` is truthy, including when career_path_id is null (a career_journey-derived chain), in which case it clears the focus instead of opening anything.

features.element: Explorer node card (role, label, competency count)
features.purpose: One step of the progression with (Current/Next/Previous/Future Role) label
features.shouldFeed: Talent Mgmt internal mobility / succession pipeline
features.gap: Not clickable — cannot open the role's competency requirements in Framework & Role Mapping. Nothing in Talent Mgmt reads this progression.

features.purpose: Share of the target role's required proficiency the employee already holds
features.shouldFeed: Talent Mgmt succession readiness — this IS the readiness score the spec asks Competency to own
features.gap: SuccessionPlanController stores its own hand-entered `readiness` enum ('ready-now', 'ready-1-2-years'…) on talent_succession_candidates and never calls this computation. Direct violation of 'no duplicated build of ratings'. Also returns null (rendered as 'Match not available') whenever the employee has zero s_skill_matrix rows — which, given assessments never write that table, is the common case.

features.element: Explorer: 'Already held' / 'Match not available' node states
features.purpose: Distinguish past roles and unscoreable roles
features.gap: 'Already held' is inferred purely from position before the current node in the chain, not from any employment history table.

features.purpose: Explains how the chain was resolved (career_path / career_journey / related / department / none)
features.gap: Honest provenance labelling — good. But 'Derived from other roles in the same department' means the card can present an arbitrary sibling role as a career step.

features.shouldFeed: Talent Mgmt internal job board / mobility requests
features.gap: Chips are inert <div>s — not buttons, no navigation, no 'express interest'. Talent's InternalJobController and MobilityRequestController never read career_journey lateral edges.

features.purpose: 'No career path to show' or a retry on failure

features.gap: Searches name only; description and step role names are not searchable.
See Create Career Path (header) — no downstream consumer.
Renders the full chain in one cell with no truncation guard — long paths overflow horizontally.

features.purpose: How many development plans point at this path
features.shouldFeed: The Development Plans tab, filtered by career_path_id
features.gap: Not clickable. The API already supports ?career_path_id= on the plans list (DevelopmentPlanController.php:111-113) and the TS type declares it, but no UI control ever sets it.
No 'created by' column even though created_by is stored.

features.element: Career Paths: row click → focus in explorer
features.purpose: Sets focusedPathId, driving the explorer card below
features.gap: The explorer below is not scrolled into view, so on a long table the click appears to do nothing.

features.element: Career Paths: row kebab → View in Explorer
features.gap: Duplicate of the row click.

features.element: Career Paths: row kebab → Edit Path
features.gap: Step replacement soft-deletes every existing step row and inserts new ones, so step ids churn on every save and any future FK to a step id would break.

features.element: Career Paths: row kebab → Delete Path
features.writes: soft-deletes path + steps; NULLs career_path_id on linked plans

features.element: Career Paths: delete confirmation dialog (Cancel / Delete)
features.purpose: Confirms and warns how many plans will be unlinked

features.element: Career Paths: empty state + 'Create Career Path' CTA

features.purpose: The list is capped rather than paged
features.gap: useCareerPaths hard-codes per_page:100 and discards response.pagination. The tab renders no Pager. A tenant with >100 career paths silently loses the rest, with no indication.
Searches course name only; employee name is a visible column but not searchable.

features.purpose: All / Not Started / In Progress / Completed / Overdue
features.gap: 'Overdue' is only ever a manually-set value on the competency side — nothing computes it from due_date.
Same 500-row cap as the employee picker.

features.purpose: Opens the assign dialog with no presets
features.gap: Same enrolment gap; and with no plan preset the assignment is untethered from any development plan or competency.
Not a link — cannot open the course in the LMS catalog.
Not a link.
Visible to the LMS admin queue but not enforced anywhere.

features.shouldFeed: Plan progress and the employee's competency level
features.gap: Status is only ever moved by a human clicking 'Mark …' here or bulk-updating in the LMS Assignment Queue. lms_course_enroll.status='completed' — the real completion signal, which the LMS genuinely tracks — never propagates to it.

Nothing in the codebase increments this from actual learning activity. It is 0 on create and only ever jumps to 100 when someone marks the row Completed (LearningAssignmentController.php:277-279 / assignmentController.php:270-275). Any intermediate value on live rows was hand-entered.
No reminders; no overdue computation on this side.

features.purpose: Title of the development plan the assignment belongs to
features.shouldFeed: Plan progress and the plan detail panel
features.gap: Display-only, and not clickable. The FK exists on every row created from a plan but is never used to influence the plan — grep of development_plan_id shows it is only ever filtered, labelled or diffed, never acted on.

features.element: Learning: row kebab → 'Mark Not Started / In Progress / Completed / Overdue'
features.shouldFeed: Plan progress; competency level uplift in s_skill_matrix
features.gap: THE OTHER HALF OF THE BROKEN LOOP. Marking a course Completed writes nothing to s_skill_matrix, nothing to the linked plan's progress, nothing to the employee's competency profile. The LMS 'BUILD skill' output never becomes a measured skill level.

features.purpose: Confirms removal, names course and employee

features.element: Learning: missing edit controls for type / due date
features.gap: The kebab menu offers only status changes and removal. A wrong due date or type can only be fixed by deleting and re-assigning.

features.purpose: Server paging and a zero-state 'Assign Learning' action
Claims to 'Track all changes, approvals, comments, and user actions across competencies and related records'
features.gap: Overclaims. The whole screen reads one table, s_competency_activity_log, written only by Api/Competency controllers. It covers zero LMS, Talent, Task or Organization/HRIT activity, so it is a competency-module audit, not a platform audit.

features.purpose: Fetches filtered rows and downloads a client-built CSV
features.writes: logs 'exported_audit_log' back into the same table
features.gap: Silent 5000-row ceiling with no warning that the export was truncated. CSV has no BOM, so Excel mangles non-ASCII names.
Preference is per-browser, not per-user on the server — it does not follow the user to another machine.
Hiding User still leaves 'User' in the sort column list logic; the sort key remains applicable but its header disappears, so an active user-sort becomes invisible.
Hiding it also hides the only record-navigation affordance in the table.

features.purpose: Count of all rows matching the current filters; click resets the action-class filter
features.gap: metrics() loads every matching row into PHP memory and counts in a loop (AuditController.php:200-221) — no SQL aggregation, no cap. On a mature tenant this is an unbounded full scan on every filter change.

features.reads: log rows whose verb maps to class 'approval'
features.gap: Number/destination mismatch. The card counts HISTORICAL approval events in the log; clicking it opens the Approvals tab, which is now the live ApprovalQueue showing PENDING items from s_competency_approvals. The two numbers are unrelated, so the card reads as a broken drilldown.

Only two verbs in the entire module produce comment-class rows — 'commented_certification' and 'commented_employee_profile'. screenLevelGaps: THE GAP -> COURSE -> LEVEL LOOP IS BROKEN AT BOTH ENDS, and the customer's premise needs correcting in one direction. (a) A development plan does NOT consume a gap from an assessment. gaps() (DevelopmentPlanController.php:594-628) computes live from s_user_skill_jobrole (required) vs s_skill_matrix (current). AssessmentController writes only s_competency_assessments and never touches s_skill_matrix; no LMS controller writes it either. The only writers of s_skill_matrix are two manual admin endpoints in EmployeeCompetencyProfileController. So 'Current' is hand-typed data, and the MEASURE half of the module never reaches the plan. (b) A development plan DOES produce an LMS assignment row (lms_assignments, source='competency') and the LMS admin queue genuinely reads it — so the customer's suspicion that no link exists is WRONG at the write step. But it is right in effect: no lms_course_enroll row is created, LmsLearningController (My Learning) never queries lms_assignments (grep: zero hits), and lms_assignments.development_plan_id is never read back into plan progress. The learner is never enrolled, and completing the course changes neither the plan nor the skill matrix.

DEVELOPMENT PLAN APPROVAL IS A DEAD END, and it is an explicit spec requirement. The plan form's 'Plan Owner' sets approver_id, which the backend turns into approval_status='pending_approval' (DevelopmentPlanController.php:425). Nothing can ever move it out of that state: ApprovalController::SUBJECTS covers only 'competency' and 'framework', and no endpoint or UI approves a plan. Worse, the 'Pending my approval only' checkbox is not scoped to the current user at all — line 119-121 filters on approval_status alone with no approver_id = context user_id, so it shows every pending plan in the tenant. And the owner dropdown is chicken-and-egg: owners() returns only users who already own a plan, so on a fresh tenant no owner can ever be selected. CompetencyManagementFeatures.txt lists 'Sign-off on individual development plans & training nominations' as a Department Head feature.

CAREER PATHS FEED NOTHING. The customer's suspicion is confirmed and the evidence is unambiguous: s_competency_career_paths and s_competency_career_path_steps are referenced by exactly four files, all under app/Http/Controllers/Api/Competency and app/Models/Competency. Talent Management's SuccessionPlanController reads only talent_succession_plans and talent_succession_candidates and stores its own hand-entered `readiness` enum ('ready-now', 'ready-1-2-years', ...). Meanwhile CareerPathController::matchPercent already computes exactly that readiness from s_user_skill_jobrole vs s_skill_matrix. This is a duplicated build of the readiness rating, which the ownership model forbids. The INPUT side is fine — the explorer correctly consumes the job-role matrix (s_user_jobrole for steps, career_journey for progression edges, s_user_skill_jobrole for required proficiency), so career paths consume the matrix but nothing consumes career paths.

THE AUDIT CENTRE IS COMPETENCY-ONLY, AND NOT EVEN ALL OF COMPETENCY. It reads one table, s_competency_activity_log, written only by Api/Competency controllers. Its 'Module' filter lists competency SCREENS, not platform modules — there is no LMS, Talent, Task or Organization/HRIT activity in it at all, despite the subtitle claiming coverage 'across competencies and related records'. Within Competency the coverage is uneven: (i) Libraries & Taxonomy, Skill Taxonomy and Taxonomy Ontology write subject_types ('skill','jobrole','jobrole-task','knowledge','ability','attitude','behaviour','invisible','<type>-taxonomy') that are absent from AuditController::SUBJECTS, so they land in the generic 'Competency Management' bucket with no record link; (ii) career path create and update log no diff, so career paths have a permanently empty Version History; (iii) assessment ratings are never audited — AssessmentController logs only 'launched_assessment' and 'deleted_assessment', so the module's core measurement act leaves no trail; (iv) only two verbs in the whole module produce comment-class rows, so the Comments tab is structurally near-empty.

EVERY DEEP LINK OUT OF THESE TWO SCREENS IS BROKEN, in three mutually inconsistent ways. Real routes are the tblmenumaster_g2g access_link strings (content-map-m2.ts: '/module/competency-management/competency-library/development-and-career-paths'), and use-content-map.ts keys modules by numeric id ('2'). cm-audit.tsx:319 pushes '/module/competency-management/{submenu_id}/{submenu_id}'; approval-queue.tsx:72 pushes '/module/m2/{submenu}/{submenu}'; cm-competency-library.tsx:797 pushes '/module/m2/{submenuId}/{submenuId}?competency_id=...'. None matches an access_link, so parseRoutePath returns null and GtgAppShell falls back to DEFAULT_ACTIVE = HOME_NAV. Consequences: the audit Record Name link and 'Open {record type}' button dump the user on the Home dashboard; the ApprovalQueue's 'Open record' does the same; and the entire competency_id drill-through into this workspace never arrives, which makes the CompetencyFocusBanner and the competency_id filters on both the plans list and the learning list unreachable dead code. The fix already exists in the codebase and is unused: useSidebarNavigation exposes resolveAccessLink() for exactly this.

NOTHING ON THIS SCREEN IS EVENT-DRIVEN, so every 'automatic' status is a lie. app/Events, app/Listeners and app/Observers do not exist and app/Jobs holds one unrelated job. Therefore: plan status never becomes 'Overdue' from a passed due_date; learning assignment status never becomes 'Overdue'; no reminder is ever sent for a plan, action or assignment deadline (CompetencyManagementFeatures.txt asks for a 'Notification/reminder engine for assessment cycles & deadlines'); a rejected approval never notifies the submitter despite the dialog promising it does; and a promotion or transfer never re-maps the plan's jobrole, so gaps are computed against a stale role snapshot (TalentManagementFeatures.txt: 'Promotion/transfer event → triggers re-mapping of employee's required competency set').

TWO CONCRETE STALE-UI BUGS FROM AN INCOMPLETE REFRESH GRAPH. (a) useDevelopmentPlans(listParams) does not include refreshKey in its params (cm-development-career.tsx:1990-2021), so ticking an action checkbox or deleting an action in the detail panel — both of which call onChanged=refresh and DO recompute plan progress server-side — leaves the left-hand table's Progress bar and Status badge showing the old values. (b) usePlanDetail depends only on planId (use-development-career.ts:290), so saving an edit from the detail panel's Edit button refreshes the list but leaves the detail panel itself showing pre-edit data.

SEVERAL FIELDS THE API SUPPORTS HAVE NO UI, and each one severs a specific integration. ActionForm has no competency_id picker even though storeAction/updateAction validate it and actions() joins s_users_skills to return competency_name — so a plan action can never be attached to the gap it closes. ActionForm has no owner_id picker, so every action silently defaults to the employee and a mentoring action cannot be assigned to the mentor. AssignLearningForm never sends competency_id even though the payload type, the validator and the DB column all exist — so no assignment records which gap it targets, and the ?competency_id= drill-through on the Learning Assignments tab can never match anything created from a plan. CareerPathForm has no job_family input despite the column, the validator and the returned CareerPathSummary.job_family field.

FREE TEXT WHERE FOREIGN KEYS BELONG. Plan focus_areas is a comma-joined string matched to competencies by case-insensitive exact NAME (isFocusArea, DevelopmentPlanController.php:1123-1131). Plan jobrole is a denormalised role-name snapshot. Career path steps store jobrole by name with a best-effort id lookup. Gap rows are keyed by skill NAME (s_user_skill_jobrole.skill joined to s_users_skills.title), so competency_id is null for any required competency the employee has never been rated on. Renaming a competency or a job role in the Library / Organization silently breaks every one of these links with no error and no migration.

PERFORMANCE: THE AUDIT SCREEN DOES NOT AGGREGATE IN SQL. metrics() (AuditController.php:200-221) and userActions() (449-491) both pull EVERY row matching the filters into PHP and count in a loop, with no cap and no pagination. The keyword search ORs four unindexed LIKE '%…%' predicates, and the action-class filter expands to roughly 30 OR'd LIKE 'prefix%' clauses. On a tenant with a mature activity log these run on every filter change, every tab switch and every page turn.

UNPAGED / CAPPED LOOKUPS THAT SILENTLY LOSE DATA: employee options capped at 500 with the ?search param never sent from the picker; course options capped at 300 with the same unused search; role options capped at 500; career paths hard-capped at per_page=100 by useCareerPaths with response.pagination discarded and no Pager rendered on the tab; audit export silently truncated at 5000 rows with no warning. In every case the UI gives no indication that results were cut off.
